requirements.rule: CASSA EDILE: for blue-collar workers, holidays (8.5%) and Christmas bonus (10%) accrue through the Cassa Edile system. The employer_cost_annual underestimates by ~18.5% of gross for blue-collar workers.
requirements.remediation: Model the operai with 12 monthly payments and the 18.5% Cassa Edile accrual (plus the provincial Cassa Edile contribution), as edilizia-ance does, then remove this limitation.

requirements.rule: The 2000 text, Art. 98 (PDF p. 97), preserves an annual one-month award for clerical employees with 20 years of actual uninterrupted service at the same company or group by 30 April 1982 (hired no later than 30 April 1962). A worker still employed in 2026 could belong to this cohort; the rule cannot be dismissed solely for age. The award uses Art. 80 items 1–14 at their 30 April 1982 values and pays whole-month fractions on non-disciplinary departure. Continued force in the current agreement is not established by the cached 2000 text. The missing calculation is cohort eligibility, worker-specific frozen pay and annual/departure payment; current salary cannot replace the frozen base.
requirements.remediation: Confirm continued force against the current agreement; for qualifying clerical workers supply the 30 April 1982 Art. 80 items 1–14 pay base and implement annual anniversary payment and whole-month pro rata on non-disciplinary departure.

requirements.rule: SENIORITY: Art. 83 (CCNL text 2000, p. 89) gives the scatti to 'l'impiegato' only (levels 2 to 8, 5 biennial scatti); the operai accrue the Anzianità professionale edile of Art. 69 (p. 78) through the Cassa Edile instead, paid out of a contribution 'a carico dei datori di lavoro, la cui misura sarà stabilita [...] con accordo tra le Organizzazioni territoriali'. The engine pays no scatti to a worker stated as operaio (seniority excluded_categories); the territorial APE contribution is not modelled, and a run of levels 1-4 that does not state the category still pays the impiegato scatti.
requirements.remediation: Add the territorial APE contribution of the province (Cassa Edile) as an employer cost.
